title: Clarent Saga: Chronicles
description:
A Fantasy Novel Meets Classic Turn-Based JRPG CombatA legendary sword. A dangerous cult. An unlikely band of heroes.

The Cult of Brax threatens the world of Gard, seeking to summon a demon lord and plunge the land into darkness.

Only Horatio, a mercenary drawn into an extraordinary adventure, and his newfound companions stand a chance of stopping them.

Their mission? Find the legendary Clarent Sword before it's too late.

Clarent Saga: Chronicles combines the storytelling of a fantasy novel with strategic turn-based battles inspired by classic JRPGs.

An Adventure Driven by Story• Discover a light-hearted fantasy tale spanning 21 chapters and approximately 80,000 words.

• Follow a colorful cast of characters through a world of danger, friendship, and adventure.

• Enjoy a streamlined experience focused on storytelling and battles, without traditional exploration.

• New to Clarent Saga? You can begin here, although playing Clarent Saga: Prologue first will give you additional context.

Master the Art of Turn-Based Combat• Choose from 20 playable characters and 20 classes.

• Exploit enemy weaknesses to stun opponents and deal devastating damage.

• Boost your skills to unleash powerful abilities.

• Experiment with over 180 skills, hundreds of equipment options, and a wide variety of enemies.

• Adapt the experience to your preferences with three difficulty settings.

A Tribute to Classic JRPGsEnjoy nostalgic pixel-art graphics and a soundtrack inspired by the unforgettable 16-bit JRPG era.

The combat system takes inspiration from modern HD-2D role-playing games while keeping battles fast, accessible, and rewarding.

A Different Kind of RPGClarent Saga: Chronicles is a narrative-first experience.

There are no traditional exploration sections or open-world environments. Instead, the game concentrates on its fantasy story, character progression, and turn-based encounters.

If you love classic JRPG combat but prefer a more direct, story-focused adventure, your next journey awaits.

Will Horatio and his companions find the Clarent Sword in time to save Gard?
description_short: Experience a light-hearted fantasy adventure blending novel-style storytelling with strategic turn-based JRPG battles. Follow Horatio and his companions across 21 chapters, master 20 playable classes, and uncover the secrets of the legendary Clarent Sword.
